findings_qualitative.value: Dozens of molecular cloudlets and filaments lie along X-ray filaments, while X-ray hotspots sit in intercloud regions.

evidence.quote: these hotspots are located on the intercloud or low-density region, but not in the direction of dense cloudlets.

claims.hypothesis: Small-scale dense cloudlets exist in the NW shell and interact with shocks
claims.result: Cloudlets with radii 0.03–0.05 pc and ~1e4 cm^-3 found along X-ray filaments
claims.finding: Shocked cloudlets and filaments resolved; inhomogeneous ISM supports a wind-bubble scenario

evidence.quote: We newly found three molecular complexes consisting of dozens of shocked molecular cloudlets and filaments

claims.hypothesis: X-ray hotspots arise from shock-cloudlet interactions with amplified B
claims.experiment: Compare CO with Chandra epochs; estimate B from variability
claims.result: B ~ 0.3–3 mG; hotspots offset 0.05–0.15 pc from CO peaks
claims.finding: Hotspots generated by shock-cloudlet interaction with mG fields

evidence.quote: We argue that X-ray hotspots were generated by shock-cloudlet interactions through magnetic-field amplification up to mG.
